identity_notes: This label identity ('Isoflavones' / 'Soy Isoflavones' / 'NovaSoy' / 'Soy germ extract') refers to an ISOLATED/CONCENTRATED isoflavone extract, not whole soy food, soy protein powder, soy milk, soy nuts, or fermented soy. A large fraction of the retrieved literature studies whole-food or soy-protein matrices standardized to isoflavone content rather than isolated extracts; those records were REJECTED as off_topic (whole-food/protein matrix) rather than kept, since the brief instructs relevance to be judged against the SAME material the label delivers -- reviewers should treat this as a judgment call, not a hard rule, since many 'soy protein containing X mg isoflavones' trials are the closest available human evidence for isoflavone dosing. Among KEPT records, a second major applicability split exists between soy-derived isoflavones (the dominant label form) and red-clover-derived isoflavones (Promensil/Rimostil/MF11RCE-type products; flagged related_form_differs throughout) and kudzu-derived isoflavones (flagged related_form_differs, and often studied for alcohol-use indications rather than menopausal/bone/lipid claims). The best-supported, most consistent EXACT-MATCH signal in this scope is for menopausal vasomotor symptoms (multiple positive RCTs and meta-analyses, e.g., 20025635, 29849181, 15283929, 40718787) and bone mineral density (28768649, 31290343, 37875614, 36012916), with effect sizes generally small-to-moderate and dependent on isoflavone chemical form (aglycone vs glycoside) and individual equol-producer status (25441486, 15640479, 30516108). Cardiovascular endpoints (lipids, endothelial function, blood pressure) and cognitive endpoints are predominantly null-to-mixed across the largest/most rigorous individual RCTs and meta-analyses (19209289, 29129666, 12072038, 22552034, 39433088), even where earlier or smaller trials were positive. Estrogenicity biomarker data (39433088, high-certainty GRADE) support a null estrogenic effect, relevant to breast-cancer and hormone-sensitive-condition safety questions. Multiple combination products (isoflavones + lactobacilli + magnolia bark + calcium/vitamin D, isoflavones + berberine) were kept but flagged related_form_differs since the isoflavone-specific contribution cannot be isolated from the combination effect.
